requirements.text: Messages and reminders should come from specific clinic staff members to reinforce patient relationships.
The system must provide an easy-to-use interface for booking, canceling, or rescheduling appointments.
The system must provide a clear view of available time slots for appointments.
The system must provide accessible instructions or guidance for patients who may struggle with using the technology.
The system must offer an option for patients to receive direct assistance from clinic staff if they encounter difficulties.
The system must include a flagging system for urgent cases that require immediate attention.
The system must allow clinicians to clearly set their availability to prevent patients from booking appointments during unavailable times.
The system must include a straightforward form for patients to request repeat prescriptions without needing to call the clinic.
The system must have a review and approval process for clinicians to ensure all prescription requests are checked for safety and accuracy before finalization.
The system must provide clear communication channels for patients to reach out with questions or concerns about their prescriptions.
The system must maintain open communication options for patients to reach out directly to clinic staff for support and assistance.
